name: Ultra Brain OS Ecosystem Management Contract
preconditions: OS Ecosystem is registered with repository https://github.com/CSY8515/OS-Ecosystem.git and release tag v0.73.
The Ultra Brain management interface and this contract are approved and version coherent.
Operational reports identify a source registered by OS Ecosystem Operational Report Contract v1.0.
Personal Secretary Operational Reporting Interface and Contract 0.61.0 remain active.
obligations: Ultra Brain maintains the OS Ecosystem registry identity, lifecycle status, declared release health, compatibility decision, and management evidence.
OS Ecosystem retains ownership of its repository, implementation, runtime, capabilities, releases, and management of Living OS and Universal Learning Engine relationships.
Living OS and Universal Learning Engine retain data, business rules, runtime decisions, versions, and independent deployment.

Operational summaries flow from Living OS or Universal Learning Engine through OS Ecosystem Personal Secretary Capability and the Ultra Brain Personal Secretary reporting boundary before advisory presentation to the User.
Every report preserves source, producer, project, report identity, timestamp, priority, and evidence references.
Raw databases, raw business records, credentials, secrets, and unbounded payloads are never transferred through this contract.
Recommendations remain advisory and consequential actions require an explicit, separate User approval transition.
The navigation artifact remains structural and does not implement UI, World, Theme, routes, rendering, or deployment.
postconditions: Registry, interface, contract, dependency, navigation, and operational-flow references are mutually coherent.
The OS Ecosystem repository and connected project ownership remain independent and unchanged.
The User receives an evidence-linked advisory report or an explicit failure result.
failure_semantics: Unknown ecosystem or source identity fails closed.
Missing evidence, incompatible versions, malformed summaries, secret-bearing data, or authority ambiguity fails closed.
A failed health or dependency check changes management status without modifying the independent ecosystem runtime.
No failure authorizes automatic recovery, rollback, repository mutation, or execution.
